name: aoe2mc.battle_royale.start
text: Battle Royale: the Corruption takes the chart from its border to its centre in %s. It scuttles all crew an' buildings in it.

name: aoe2mc.bot.cannot_build
text: I can nay build a %s thar now.

name: aoe2mc.bot.cannot_train
text: I can nay train that crewman: I have no building fer it.

name: aoe2mc.bot.flare_two
text: Flare two places fer the wall.

name: aoe2mc.bot.no_market
text: I have no market: I can nay send tribute.

name: aoe2mc.bot.no_wall_resources
text: I have nay enough resources fer a wall.

name: aoe2mc.bot.no_water
text: I have no water near me port: I can nay build a navy.

name: aoe2mc.bot.onager_no_trees
text: Me onagers can nay cut trees.

name: aoe2mc.build.flat
text: The %s must stand on flat ground.

name: aoe2mc.build.gate_spot
text: A %s must go on 4 tiles of an own wall in a straight line, or on 3 diagonal tiles.

name: aoe2mc.build.shore
text: A %s must stand on water next to th' shore.

name: aoe2mc.build.tiles_cost
text: Nay enough resources: %s tiles of %s cost %s.

name: aoe2mc.build.wall_end
text: %s: right click the end o' th' wall.

name: aoe2mc.build.water
text: A %s must stand on the water.

name: aoe2mc.camera.fov
text: The smartly camera makes the held item swing. To keep it still, set Options > Accessibility Settings > View Bobbing to OFF. The camera also makes the view wider, which shows more o' th' chart. To keep the normal view, set Options > Accessibility Settings > FOV Effects to 0 %.

name: aoe2mc.camera.on
text: Camera: on, speed x%s. Shift right click: next speed.

name: aoe2mc.challenge.battle-formations
text: Defeat all scallywag crew an' lose few crew

name: aoe2mc.challenge.booming
text: Train 100 villagers an' advance to th' Imperial Age

name: aoe2mc.challenge.defending-against-a-rush
text: Advance to th' Castle Age an' survive the scallywags raids

name: aoe2mc.challenge.early-economy
text: Gather 200 grub, 200 timber, 100 doubloons an' 200 rock, train 21 villagers, build a lumber camp an' a mill, an' advance to th' Feudal Age

name: aoe2mc.challenge.fast-castle-age
text: Train 27 villagers, build 5 houses an' advance to th' Castle Age

name: aoe2mc.challenge.lost_bronze
text: %s crew be sunk, bronze medal up to %s

name: aoe2mc.challenge.lost_gold
text: %s crew be sunk, doubloons medal up to %s

name: aoe2mc.challenge.lost_silver
text: %s crew be sunk, silver medal up to %s

name: aoe2mc.cheat.sharing
text: Sharing be caring: yer income goes to yer allies

name: aoe2mc.conquest.allies_end
text: Only allies be left: the alliances end. The last captain alive plunders the victory.

name: aoe2mc.controls.attack
text: Raid: select military crew, then right click an scallywag.

name: aoe2mc.controls.build
text: Build: select villagers, right click 'em fer the build menu, select a building, then left click the ground. Shift + left click: place more. Right click: cancel.

name: aoe2mc.controls.camera
text: Camera: right click with the spyglass Camera (hotbar key 2): ye walk smartly high above the chart. Shift right click: the next speed. Right click again: ye fly down.

name: aoe2mc.controls.garrison
text: Garrison: select crew, then right click yer own building. Its menu lets 'em out. Port centre menu: Ring Port Bell.

name: aoe2mc.controls.gather
text: Gather: select villagers, then right click a tree, a fruit bush, a mine or a farm.

name: aoe2mc.controls.goto
text: Go to: right click with the compass Go to (hotbar key 3): a menu of yer port centres, yer control groups an' the next idle villager.

name: aoe2mc.controls.groups
text: Control groups: select crew, take a group item (hotbar keys 5 to 9) an' Shift + right click to save the selection. Right click: select the group.

name: aoe2mc.controls.head
text: Controls (hold the carrot on a stick; the action bar shows the next step):

name: aoe2mc.controls.menu
text: Game menu: right click with the book Game menu (hotbar key 4): diplomacy an' tribute, flare, save, pause an' the tech tree.

name: aoe2mc.controls.move
text: Move: with a selection, right click the ground.

name: aoe2mc.controls.research
text: Research an' age up: right click yer own building an' click a technology or the next age in its menu.

name: aoe2mc.controls.select
text: Select: left click a crewman. Hold left click an' spy across the ground: a selection box. Right click: give orders.

name: aoe2mc.controls.train
text: Train: right click yer own building (port centre, barracks ...) an' click a crewman in its menu.

name: aoe2mc.diplomacy.changed
text: Captain %s changed its stance to ye: %s.

name: aoe2mc.diplomacy.speed
text: Captain %s set the game speed to %s.

name: aoe2mc.follow.refuse_guard
text: Guard: click an own crewman or building

name: aoe2mc.garrison.bell_seek
text: The port bell rings: %s villagers seek shelter

name: aoe2mc.gather.corner
text: Selection box: click the other corner

name: aoe2mc.hints.attack_ground
text: Raid Ground: right click the ground

name: aoe2mc.hints.attack_move
text: Raid Move: right click the ground

name: aoe2mc.hints.building
text: Place the %s: right click the ground · Shift + right click: place more · Cancel: /trigger aoe_build set 0

name: aoe2mc.hints.building_paper
text: %s: left click to place · Shift: place more · Right click: cancel

name: aoe2mc.hints.corner
text: Selection box: right click the other corner

name: aoe2mc.hints.follow
text: Follow: right click an own or allied crewman

name: aoe2mc.hints.guard
text: Guard: right click an own or allied crewman or building

name: aoe2mc.hints.military
text: %s · Right click: raid an scallywag, stance menu · %s

name: aoe2mc.hints.none
text: Left click: select a crewman · Hold left click: selection box

name: aoe2mc.hints.none_wand
text: Right click: select a crewman · Wand: selection box

name: aoe2mc.hints.villagers
text: %s · Right click: gather, build, build menu · %s

name: aoe2mc.recap.next
text: The game be over. Right click the Recap book in yer hand to spy the results. Avast the game program with Ctrl-C in its console.

name: aoe2mc.repair.no_resources
text: Nay enough resources to repair the %s.

name: aoe2mc.replay.hill_won
text: %s held the monument: King o' th' Hill victory at %s.

name: aoe2mc.replay.join_help
text: Double-tap Shift: spectator view (fly through blocks). Right click the hotbar items: replay control.

name: aoe2mc.replay.king_died
text: : the King died at %s. Regicide: the captain be out.

name: aoe2mc.replay.live_jump
text: Live replay: the jump stops at the delay behind the game.

name: aoe2mc.replay.no_camera
text: This record has no camera of its captain.

name: aoe2mc.replay.relic_won
text: takes the relic to a monastery an' plunders the victory.

name: aoe2mc.replay.restart_jump
text: The server restarts fer the jump back: join it again.

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_economy
text: : villagers trained %s, gathered %s, idle villager time %s, idle TC time %s

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_hill_holds
text: : holds the monument (King o' th' Hill)

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_military
text: : military crew trained %s, crew be sunk %s, buildings be sunk %s, APM %s%s

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_relic
text: : plunders the victory, relic in a monastery %s (Capture the Relic)

name: aoe2mc.replay.town_fell
text: : the port centre fell at %s. Sudden Death: the captain be out.

name: aoe2mc.replay_input.help
text: Replay: right click the items in yer hotbar, or click:

name: aoe2mc.run.chat_hint
text: Chat: a normal line goes to all, /tm TEXT to yer allies, /msg NAME TEXT to one person.

name: aoe2mc.run.welcome_first
text: First step: hold the command stick an' right click one of yer villagers.

name: aoe2mc.run.welcome_first_paper
text: First step: hold the command stick an' left click one of yer villagers.

name: aoe2mc.run.welcome_goal
text: Goal: triumph the game. Victory setting: %s.

name: aoe2mc.stance.no_ground
text: No crewman can raid the ground

name: aoe2mc.train.rally
text: Right click the ground fer the rally point.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.ended
text: The treaty ended: captains can raid now.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.refuse
text: Treaty: ye can nay raid before %s.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.refuse_endless
text: Treaty: ye can nay raid in this game.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.start
text: Treaty: no captain can raid another captain before %s.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.start_endless
text: Treaty: no captain can raid another captain in this game.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.barracks
text: Build a barracks: right click on a selected villager, choose the barracks an' place it. The action bar above the hotbar tells ye where to place it.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camera
text: Move smartly over the chart: right click with the "Camera" item, walk, then right click with it again.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camp
text: Scuttle the scallywags camp in the middle o' th' chart: select yer Militia an' right click on a building. The boss bar at the top shows the step.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camps
text: Build a lumber camp near the trees an' a mill near the berries. The sidebar on the right shows the timber they cost.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.complete
text: The tutorial be complete. Next: play a game against the bot: python3 game/run.py OUTWorld --play --bot

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.feudal
text: Advance to th' Feudal Age: right click on yer port centre an' choose the Feudal Age. The sidebar on the right shows yer grub.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.food
text: Gather 100 grub: send a villager to th' berries. The sidebar on the right shows yer grub.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.house
text: Build a house: right click on a selected villager, choose the house an' place it. The action bar above the hotbar tells ye where to place it.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.militia
text: Train 3 Militia: right click on yer barracks an' choose the militia. The sidebar on the right shows yer grub an' doubloons.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.raid
text: The scallywags raids yer villagers! Click the red alert line in the chat to go thar, then select yer Militia an' right click on the scallywags. The boss bar at the top shows the health o' th' selected crewman.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.select
text: Select a villager: left click on one of yer villagers with the command stick. The boss bar at the top shows the selected crewman, the action bar above the hotbar shows the next action.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_barracks
text: TIP: the barracks trains infantry. Infantry be cheap an' fine against buildings.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_camp
text: TIP: raid with all yer crew together. A small group dies before it can do damage.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_camps
text: TIP: build the drop-off buildings near the resources, so that the villagers walk a short way.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_feudal
text: TIP: the next age unlocks fresh buildings, crew an' technologies. Keep the villagers at work while ye advance.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_food
text: TIP: berries near a mill be a safe set sail of grub. Later, farms give grub that does nay end.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_house
text: TIP: a house gives room fer 5 more population. Spy at the population in the sidebar an' build houses before it be full.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_militia
text: TIP: ye can queue up to 15 crew in a building when ye have the resources.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_raid
text: TIP: in AoE2 the port bell sends the villagers into the port centre. Ring it when the scallywags raids yer port.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_select
text: TIP: the Idle line o' th' sidebar on the right counts yer villagers with no work. Give 'em work.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_villager
text: TIP: train villagers all the time in the first ages. More villagers give more resources.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_wood
text: TIP: villagers gather faster near a drop-off building. Build a lumber camp next to th' trees.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.villager
text: Train a villager: right click on yer port centre an' choose the villager. The sidebar on the right shows the grub it costs.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.wood
text: Gather 50 timber: select a villager an' right click on a tree. The sidebar on the right shows yer timber.

name: aoe2mc.wonder.destroyed
text: The wonder of captain %s be scuttled.
